goal: How many running activities did I do this week in the OpenTracks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.
summary:
I answered **1**: as far as I can tell, you did one running activity this week (Mon Oct 9 – Sun Oct 15). It's "Trying and failing to keep up with John", recorded yesterday.

The answer rests partly on icons. OpenTracks doesn't show the activity type as text in the list or on a track's stats screen. I counted that track as a run because its icon matches the one on "Off-road Run" and "Running Challenge" (both Oct 6, so outside this week).

Three other tracks this week use an upright walking-figure icon: "Trail Hike", "Active Rest Day" and "Hill Walk". I opened only "Hill Walk", and its stats screen also shows no type. If either of the other two is actually logged as running, the count would be higher.
